content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Telecom and media billing and operations software for communications operators, not government defense or infrastructure engineering services."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Government consulting, cybersecurity and engineering services for defense, intelligence and civilian agencies, closely matching Parsons' business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Manufacturer of meters, filters and test equipment selling products to utilities and OEMs, not an engineering services provider."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Network security hardware and subscriptions sold through channel partners; a product company rather than a government services provider."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Engineering, consulting and program management services for government, defense and infrastructure owners, matching Parsons' service model."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Construction and maintenance contractor building telecom, energy and pipeline networks, not engineering services for government defense customers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"IP communications software and appliances for telecom carriers and enterprises, a different product business from Parsons."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Engineering and consulting services in water, environment and infrastructure sold mainly to government agencies, similar to Parsons' infrastructure work."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Designs and manufactures network test instruments and optical components, a hardware and equipment business unlike Parsons."}]}
